acceptanceCriteria: `corvint-tasks run --host claude-code` drives implementer, reviewer and integrator roles with the same lease, WAIT/resume, effort and wall-time bounds, review independence and integration binding as the Codex host, under an accepted spec requirement.
A missing, unpinned or unsupported claude-code executable is refused with a named code before any lease is taken; token usage is observed or reported NOT_OBSERVED, never invented.
Focused tests plus a live qualification on a disposable program (never the live queue), with independent review, CEM and native completion retained.
body: Split from GitHub issue 354 by owner decision 2026-10-04: issue 354 closes on multi-repository programs plus Codex continuation; each additional supervisor host is its own native ticket. Issue 354 asked for host adapters beyond Codex so mixed-host programs can supervise every role. Today `corvint-tasks run` supports only `--host codex` (pinned executable, Core CLI required; see `corvint-tasks help` supervisionLimits). Code: internal/tasks/supervisor, internal/tasks/store/program_run.go, internal/tasks/intent/supervision.go.
title: supervisor: Claude Code host adapter for corvint-tasks run (split from GH 354)
